task_instance: Build a minimal web app that embeds the Zoom Meeting SDK 'Client View' (full-page ZoomMtg experience) following the skill's initialization flow (checkSystemRequirements -> preLoadWasm/prepareWebSDK -> i18n.load -> ZoomMtg.init -> ZoomMtg.join), and actually join a Zoom meeting through it.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is a working full-page Zoom meeting join. ZoomMtg.join() requires a `signature` field that must be a JWT signed server-side with a Zoom Meeting SDK app's SDK Key + SDK Secret (obtained by registering an app in a Zoom developer/marketplace account), plus a real meeting number/password from a live Zoom meeting. There is no way to generate a valid signature or exercise a real join without such Zoom account credentials, which the sandbox rules forbid acquiring/using (no account-bound services, no credential lookup). I could not work around this, so I stopped at that boundary as instructed. Two secondary, non-blocking limitations were also discovered along the way: (1) the CDN-based installation path documented in the skill (loading JS from https://source.zoom.us/...) is blocked by the sandbox's egress proxy policy (curl to source.zoom.us returned 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403'), so only the npm-based installation path was usable; (2) no functional browser binary is present to actually render/screenshot the UI (`chromium-browser` is a stub requiring `snap install chromium`, and snapd is not running), so the bundled app could not be visually verified in a real browser, only built/inspected statically.
evidence:
Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_div/anthropics__knowledge-work-plugins__client-view@developer-sandbox

1. `npm install @zoom/meetingsdk --save` succeeded (added 20 packages, no credentials needed) -> node_modules/@zoom/meetingsdk installed, version 6.5.0.
2. Verified the package's public API matches the skill doc: `node_modules/@zoom/meetingsdk/index.d.ts` declares the documented `initArgs` shape (leaveUrl, debug, patchJsMedia, etc.) and `index.js` exports `ZoomMtg`.
3. Wrote app.src.js implementing the exact init flow from the skill (checkSystemRequirements, preLoadWasm, prepareWebSDK, i18n.load/onLoad, ZoomMtg.init with leaveUrl/patchJsMedia/disableCORP, and a join-form handler building a sanitized joinPayload per the skill's 'Join Payload Sanitization Gotcha').
4. Wrote index.html embedding a #zmmtg-root-safe layout and a join form (meetingNumber, userName, passWord, signature fields) reflecting the documented required ZoomMtg.join() parameters.
5. Bundled the app for the browser with esbuild: `npx esbuild app.src.js --bundle --outfile=app.js --platform=browser` succeeded, producing app.js (10.0MB, includes React/Redux/Lodash vendor deps required by the SDK).
6. Attempted the skill's alternative CDN installation path: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://source.zoom.us/3.13.0/lib/vendor/react.min.js` -> curl exit 56, 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403' (egress proxy denies source.zoom.us per organization policy). Confirms only the npm path is viable here.
7. Checked for a browser to actually load/verify the page: `which chromium-browser` found a binary, but running `chromium-browser --version` returned 'Command chromium-browser requires the chromium snap to be installed. Please install it with: snap install chromium'; `snap install chromium` failed with 'cannot communicate with server: dial unix /run/snapd.socket: connect: no such file or directory' (snapd not running). No other browser (firefox/google-chrome) present. So the built page could not be opened/screenshotted to confirm the UI actually renders and reaches the join step.
8. Given (6) network limits and (7) no browser, and that the true core deliverable -- actually joining a meeting -- needs a signature signed with a Zoom SDK Key/Secret from a registered Zoom developer account plus a live meeting, I stopped at this credential/account boundary per the safety rules rather than fabricate a fake signature or claim success.

Files produced (all within the work directory): package.json, package-lock.json, node_modules/@zoom/meetingsdk (installed dependency), index.html, app.src.js, app.js (bundled).
